guidance.statement: Management expects to maintain EBITDA margins within a specific comfort corridor over the full year.
guidance.quote: our objective is to drive for faster growth... we are confident that we will be at the upper end of this 20%, 24% range.

guidance.statement: Management aims to maintain price growth in a specific range, though not as a formulated quarterly number.
guidance.quote: in the zone of about 100 to 150 bps... I think you should continue to expect, I think it would be our endeavor

guidance.statement: The company intends to sustain and improve underlying volume growth momentum in the coming years.
guidance.quote: we would like to continue to sustain that momentum, and we will continue to grow it in the medium term and perhaps year-on-year.

guidance.statement: Management expects to bring the B2B segment back to a specific growth level.
guidance.quote: bring back our entire B2B back into at least mid-teens, so double digit and mid-teens.

achieved.claim: Domestic business reported underlying volume growth of 11% despite export challenges.
Stand-alone EBITDA margins improved to 24.5% despite one-time wage code provisions.
Consumer and Bazaar business achieved underlying volume growth of 9.7%.
International subsidiaries grew top line by 6% and EBITDA by 19%.

pushback.concern: Why hasn't increased A&SP spending yielded higher incremental volume growth beyond 9-10%?
Potential slowdown in real estate impacting the Consumer and Bazaar segment.
Sustainability of price growth given benign input costs and competitive pressures.
Market share loss in waterproofing to decorative paint companies.

output.tone_why: Management emphasizes strong domestic volume growth and successful category creation despite significant export declines.
